USE [ReconControl]
GO

INSERT INTO [dbo].[tbl_MSRB_TradesReportedLate]
(
 dtcNumber,
 [CUSIP],
 [BS] ,
 [tradeType] ,
 [EBS] ,
 [ParValue] ,
 [Price] ,
 [XREF] ,
 [tradeDate] ,
 [settlementDate] ,
 [submissionDate] ,
 [contraAlpha] ,
 [contraFullName] ,
 [reasonForLate] ,
 [groupResponsible] ,
 [personResponsible] ,
 [explanation] ,
 [fileName] ,
 [loadDate] 
) 
SELECT 
 A.dtcNumber,
 A.[CUSIP],
 A.[BS] ,
 A.[tradeType] ,
 A.[EBS] ,
 A.[ParValue] ,
 A.[Price] ,
 A.[XREF] ,
 CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(A.[tradeDate]) = 1 THEN Convert(SmallDateTime, (Convert(Float,A.[tradeDate])))  ELSE A.[tradeDate] END,
 CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(A.[settlementDate]) = 1 THEN Convert(SmallDateTime, (Convert(Float,A.[settlementDate]))) ELSE A.[settlementDate] END,
 CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(A.[submissionDate]) = 1 THEN Convert(SmallDateTime, (Convert(Float,A.[submissionDate]))) ELSE A.[submissionDate] END,
 A.[contraAlpha] ,
 A.[contraFullName] ,
 A.[reasonForLate] ,
 A.[groupResponsible] ,
 A.[personResponsible] ,
 A.[explanation] ,
 A.[fileName] ,
 A.[loadDate] 
FROM [dbo].[tbl_MSRB_TradesReportedLate_Staging] A
LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[tbl_MSRB_TradesReportedLate] B
ON A.[fileName] = B.[fileName]
where B.fileName IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(1) AS NumRows FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_MSRB_tradesReportedLate]
WHERE loadDate>= CAST(GetDate() as Date)

USE [ReconControl]
GO

INSERT INTO [dbo].[tbl_MSRB_TradesReportedVolume]
(
       [cusip]
      ,[tradeDate]
      ,[parValue]
      ,[buySell]
      ,[tradeType]
      ,[tradeStatus]
      ,[settlementDate]
      ,[submissionDate]
      ,[clearingId]
      ,[effectingBroker]
      ,[capacity]
      ,[dollarPrice]
      ,[regulatoryDollarPrice]
      ,[yield]
      ,[commission]
      ,[accruedInterest]
      ,[finalMoney]
      ,[concession]
      ,[weightedAvePrice]
      ,[specialConditionInd]
      ,[contraClearingId]
      ,[contraEffectingBroker]
      ,[contraCapacity]
      ,[TradeReportInd]
      ,[SettlementTypeInd]
      ,[extendedSettlement]
      ,[issueType]
      ,[xref]
      ,[previousXref]
      ,[tid]
      ,[matchTid]
      ,[regId]
      ,[messageSenderId]
      ,[reversalInd]
      ,[ReversalControlNum]
      ,[meor]
      ,[marketOfExecution]
      ,[exportDate]
      ,[filename]
      ,[loadDate]
) 
SELECT A.[cusip]
      ,CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(A.[tradeDate]) = 1 THEN Convert(SmallDateTime, (Convert(Float,A.[tradeDate])))  ELSE A.[tradeDate] END
      ,A.[parValue]
      ,A.[buySell]
      ,A.[tradeType]
      ,A.[tradeStatus]
   ,CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(A.[settlementDate]) = 1 THEN Convert(SmallDateTime, (Convert(Float,A.[settlementDate]))) ELSE A.[settlementDate] END
   ,CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(A.[submissionDate]) = 1 THEN Convert(SmallDateTime, (Convert(Float,A.[submissionDate]))) ELSE A.[submissionDate] END
      ,A.[clearingId]
      ,A.[effectingBroker]
      ,A.[capacity]
      ,A.[dollarPrice]
      ,A.[regulatoryDollarPrice]
      ,A.[yield]
      ,A.[commission]
      ,A.[accruedInterest]
      ,A.[finalMoney]
      ,A.[concession]
      ,A.[weightedAvePrice]
      ,A.[specialConditionInd]
      ,A.[contraClearingId]
      ,A.[contraEffectingBroker]
      ,A.[contraCapacity]
      ,A.[TradeReportInd]
      ,A.[SettlementTypeInd]
      ,A.[extendedSettlement]
      ,A.[issueType]
      ,A.[xref]
      ,A.[previousXref]
      ,A.[tid]
      ,A.[matchTid]
      ,A.[regId]
      ,A.[messageSenderId]
      ,A.[reversalInd]
      ,A.[ReversalControlNum]
      ,A.[meor]
      ,A.[marketOfExecution]
      , CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(A.[exportDate]) = 1 THEN Convert(SmallDateTime, (Convert(Float,A.[exportDate]))) ELSE A.[exportDate] END
      ,A.[filename]
      ,A.[loadDate]
FROM [dbo].[tbl_MSRB_TradesReportedVolume_Staging] A
LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[tbl_MSRB_TradesReportedVolume] B
ON A.[fileName] = B.[fileName]
where B.fileName IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(1) AS NumRows FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].tbl_MSRB_TradesReportedVolume
WHERE loadDate>= CAST(GetDate() as Date)
